# Nightwalk: Focus Expedition

> Nightwalk is a free iPhone focus timer. Start a session and an expedition party sets out across the dark, lit by one lantern. The party walks only while you stay off your phone; leave the app and it stops. Spoils that survive a session become ember, which recruits and promotes the party (lantern bearer, scout, warden, finder), so a stronger party walks further. Session lengths are 15, 25, 45 or 60 minutes. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, and no network code — it works fully offline.

## The three rules

1. Leave the app and the party stops. Come back within 15 seconds and it walks on; stay away longer and the run is lost, with 40% of its spoils recovered.
2. Locking the phone is not leaving. Screen off counts as focusing, and the march continues.
3. Focusing longer is never worse. Nothing dies, the party cannot be wiped out, and the minutes you focused always count.
